notes: «وَ رَوَى زُرَارَةُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ» names the Imam inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2), not imam_in_text
«قُلْتُ لَهُ» is زرارة asking the Imam, who answers: the Imam is the last link in his own place
the blessing «عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» is not part of the surface
